faceMatch.title: Face Matching
faceMatch.subtitle: Processing region: {{region}}
faceMatch.legalNotice: Important: before Match, customer de-duplication or the Unwelcome Persons List runs on real customers, the legal sign-off, privacy impact assessment and signage records must be in place. Missing records are now shown as red warnings and no longer block saving or enabling, but they are still legally required before running on real customers. This page does not replace legal judgement.
faceMatch.noPermission: This account has no permission for any Face Matching tab

disabled.title: Feature not enabled
disabled.readOnly: View only for now: saving, uploading, withdrawing, approving and reviewing are unavailable.

errors.FACE_MATCH_DISABLED: Face matching is not enabled (Tencent Cloud region or admin credentials are missing).
errors.FACE_MATCH_STORE_NOT_CONFIGURED: The private photo bucket is not configured, so photos cannot be uploaded or viewed.
errors.FACE_MATCH_FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.FACE_MATCH_STORE_FORBIDDEN: This store is outside the stores you can act on.
errors.FACE_MATCH_STORE_INVALID: The store code is not valid.
errors.FACE_MATCH_FIELD_INVALID: The submitted content is not valid (including file type, size or count). Check it and try again.
errors.FACE_MATCH_NOT_FOUND: The record was not found, or you cannot act on it.
errors.FACE_MATCH_GATE_NOT_MET: Enablement prerequisites not met: fill in the missing items listed on the right, then save (missing compliance records are only warnings and are not listed here).
errors.FACE_MATCH_CONSENT_WITHDRAWN: This consent has been withdrawn and cannot be used for enrolment. Record consent again.
errors.FACE_MATCH_NSW_NOTICE_REQUIRED: NSW store staff need a written notice date.
errors.FACE_MATCH_NSW_NOTICE_TOO_RECENT: For NSW store staff the written notice must be at least 14 days before consent was signed.
errors.FACE_MATCH_ENROLLMENT_EXISTS: This staff member already has a valid enrolment. Withdraw it before enrolling again.
errors.FACE_MATCH_PHOTO_UNUSABLE: A photo cannot be used (no clear single front-facing face detected, or quality is too low). Use different photos.
errors.FACE_MATCH_WITHDRAW_PENDING: Deletion at Tencent Cloud did not finish, so the enrolment is still valid. Try the withdrawal again later.
errors.FACE_MATCH_TENCENT_AUTH: Tencent Cloud authentication failed. Ask an administrator to check the admin credentials.
errors.FACE_MATCH_TENCENT_BUSY: Tencent Cloud is busy. Try again later.
errors.FACE_MATCH_TENCENT_LIMIT: The Tencent Cloud person or face limit has been reached. Contact an administrator.
errors.FACE_MATCH_TENCENT_CONFLICT: Data conflict at Tencent Cloud. Try again later; contact an administrator if it keeps happening.
errors.FACE_MATCH_TENCENT_UNAVAILABLE: Tencent Cloud is unavailable. Try again later.
errors.FACE_MATCH_TENCENT_ERROR: Tencent Cloud processing failed. Try again later; contact an administrator if it keeps failing.
errors.FACE_MATCH_ENTRY_NOT_PENDING: This entry is not pending approval. Refresh and try again.
errors.FACE_MATCH_APPROVER_IS_SUBMITTER: The submitter cannot approve their own entry (administrators excepted).
errors.FACE_MATCH_ALREADY_APPROVED_BY_YOU: You have already approved this entry; a different approver is needed.
errors.FACE_MATCH_ENTRY_EXPIRED: This entry has expired and can no longer be approved.
errors.FACE_MATCH_UNWELCOME_NOT_ENABLED: None of the entry's stores has turned on the Unwelcome Persons List yet, so it cannot be approved. Turn it on in the store profile first.
errors.FACE_MATCH_ENTRY_CHANGED: The entry was just changed by someone else. Refresh and try again.
errors.FACE_MATCH_TASK_CLOSED: This review task is already finished.
errors.FACE_MATCH_SAME_REVIEWER: The second reviewer must be a different person from the first. Ask another colleague with review permission.
errors.FACE_MATCH_TASK_CHANGED: The task was just handled by someone else. Refresh and try again.
errors.FACE_MATCH_IMAGE_GONE: The image has been cleaned up or does not exist, so this task can no longer be reviewed.
errors.FACE_MATCH_IMAGE_TOO_LARGE: The image is too large to display.
errors.FACE_MATCH_IMAGE_UNSUPPORTED: The image format is not supported.
errors.FACE_MATCH_STORE_DENIED: The image store denied access. Ask an administrator to check permissions.
errors.FACE_MATCH_STORE_TIMEOUT: Loading the image timed out. Try again later.
errors.FACE_MATCH_STORE_ERROR: Failed to load the image. Try again later.
errors.FACE_MATCH_AUDIT_FAILED: The audit record could not be written, so the action was not completed (no image is returned). Try again later.
errors.FACE_MATCH_TIMEZONE_UNAVAILABLE: The server cannot determine the store time zone. Contact an administrator.

profile.pickStoreHint: Click a store in the table above or use the dropdown, then edit its profile.
profile.savedWithWarnings: Store profile saved, but {{count}} compliance record(s) are still incomplete: they must be completed before running on real customers
profile.neverSaved: This store has no saved profile yet; the defaults (Off) apply.

mode.offHint: Off: captures from this store's cameras are not processed.
mode.captureHint: Capture: keeps everything and lets you view images in admin; only for integration testing where cameras capture informed, consenting internal people. Allowed subjects is required.
mode.matchHint: Match: matches captures and keeps no unmatched images. Missing legal sign-off and related records show as red warnings (they do not block enabling) and must be completed before it runs on real customers.

hints.evaluateMatch: Evaluate only, with no effect on the store; requires Capture mode.
hints.staffExclusion: Excludes enrolled staff from traffic counts; needs store members with a valid consent and enrolment.
hints.trafficDedup: De-duplicates customers by face per day. High legal risk. A missing de-duplication legal sign-off or other record shows as a red warning and does not block enabling, but it must be completed before running on real customers. Capture mode is for informed internal people only and does not need these records.
hints.unwelcomeList: Alerts staff on a list match and starts two-person review. Missing assessment, legal sign-off, signage or training records show as red warnings and do not block enabling, but they must be completed before running on real customers. Capture mode is for informed internal people only and does not need these records, for pre-launch testing; warnings are recalculated when you switch to Match.
hints.allowedSubjects: Required for Capture mode: say who may appear in front of the cameras, all informed and consenting.
hints.signage: The signage must state that face recognition technology is used.
hints.staffNoticeNsw: This store is in NSW: staff surveillance notice must be given at least 14 days ahead.
hints.staffNoticeOther: Usually not needed outside NSW; record it here if a notice was given.
hints.timeZone: Leave blank to detect automatically. Effective time zone: {{zone}}; state: {{jurisdiction}}.
hints.crossBorderRegion: Which region was reviewed. Currently configured processing region: {{region}}. If the region changes, every store's review record becomes void.
hints.dedupSignoff: Sign-off specific to customer de-duplication, separate from the list's sign-off.
hints.unwelcomeAssessment: Should cover this store's incident frequency, alternatives already tried and a proportionality analysis.
hints.unwelcomeSignoff: Sign-off specific to the Unwelcome Persons List, separate from the de-duplication sign-off.

staff.intro: Enrolled faces are used only to exclude staff from traffic counts, never for attendance, performance or any other purpose. Participation is voluntary, and declining or withdrawing has no adverse consequence. A valid consent record is required before enrolment.
staff.objectStoreMissing: The private photo bucket is not configured, so consent scans and enrolment photos cannot be uploaded.
staff.pickStoreHint: Select a store to list its staff.
staff.name: Staff
staff.nswNotice: This staff member's stores include an NSW store: written notice is required at least 14 days before enrolment. The notice date must be entered when recording consent, and less than 14 days is rejected.

consent.title: Record consent: {{name}}
consent.purposeNotice: Key points of the consent form: used only to exclude staff from traffic counts, never for attendance, performance or other purposes; voluntary, with no adverse consequence for withdrawing; data is sent to Tencent Cloud; signed separately from the employment contract.
consent.versionHint: Match the version number finalised by the lawyer.
consent.nswNoticeHint: Required for NSW store staff, and at least {{days}} days before the consent was signed.
consent.scanHint: PDF / JPG / PNG, up to 10MB; required for paper consent.
consent.withdrawWarning: Withdrawing consent also withdraws every active enrolment under it and deletes the face data held at Tencent Cloud. This cannot be undone; to enrol again, consent must be recorded again.
consent.withdrawPending: Consent withdrawn, but deletion at Tencent Cloud is still pending for {{count}} enrolment(s); the system will keep retrying.

enrollment.needConsent: A valid consent record is needed first
enrollment.title: Enrol face: {{name}}
enrollment.purposeNotice: Enrolment photos are used only to exclude staff from traffic counts. Upload clear, front-facing, unobstructed photos of the same person.
enrollment.pendingRemoteDeletion: Deletion at Tencent Cloud is still pending; the system will keep retrying.
enrollment.withdrawWarning: Withdrawing deletes this staff member's face data at Tencent Cloud and their enrolment photos. This cannot be undone.

traffic.estimateNotice: Unique visitors is an estimate: camera angle, distance and occlusion can make one person count as two (too high) or two people as one (too low). Use it as a trend, not an exact headcount.
traffic.uniqueVisitorTip: Estimate: the same person may be counted twice or missed.
traffic.pickHint: Pick a store and a date range, then click Search. A single day shows an hourly breakdown.
traffic.empty: No data in the selected range

audit.intro: Every management action is recorded here for compliance audit: profile changes, consent, enrolment, list entries and reviews.

unwelcome.intro: The Unwelcome Persons List is for serious incidents only: violence or threats, organised or documented repeat theft, or other cases confirmed by two approvers; never for ordinary shoplifting. Every entry needs an evidence reference and an expiry date (at most 12 months) and must be approved by someone other than the submitter.
unwelcome.objectStoreMissing: The private photo bucket is not configured, so entries with photos cannot be submitted.

form.title: Submit an Unwelcome Persons List entry
form.scopeNotice: Confirm the incident is serious. An entry stores only the incident category, evidence reference and reference photos; do not enter names or private details in any field. It takes effect only after another person with approval permission approves it; an administrator can approve it alone.
form.otherNeedsTwo: Entries with the Other category need two different approvers before they take effect; one administrator's approval is enough.
form.evidenceRefHint: Enter the incident record or police report number. Do not enter names or other private details.
form.storeScopeHint: Default to the store where the incident happened; select at least one.
form.expiresHint: Required, at most {{months}} months from today ({{latest}}); the entry is deactivated and deleted when it expires.
form.photosHint: Upload {{min}}-{{max}} photos; used only for side-by-side comparison during review.

approve.title: Approve this entry?
approve.content: Once approved the entry takes effect and cameras in the stores in scope start matching against it.
approve.contentTwo: This entry needs {{needed}} different approvers and has {{done}} so far. Your approval counts toward that; it takes effect only when complete, except that one administrator's approval takes effect immediately.

withdraw.title: Withdraw entry
withdraw.warning: The entry becomes inactive immediately and its face data at Tencent Cloud and reference photos are deleted. This cannot be undone.

dispute.title: Dispute and correction note
dispute.description: When a person asks about or disputes their record it must be handled within 30 days. Record what was done here, without names or private details.
dispute.label: Note

unwelcome.cleanupPendingTip: The entry is inactive, but the person at Tencent Cloud or the reference photos are not fully deleted yet; the system will keep cleaning up.

review.intro: A review task comes from a possible match between a camera capture and the list. Two different people must each compare the live capture with the reference photos. If either says it is not the same person, the task is dismissed. The system never refuses service or notifies police automatically.
review.suspectedNotice: Suspected match (similarity {{percent}}%) - this is not the probability that it is the same person; two people must confirm manually
review.sensitiveNotice: This is sensitive biometric information. Viewing is logged; do not screenshot or share it. Names and incident details are not shown here.
review.similarity: Similarity {{percent}}% (not the probability of being the same person)
review.notProbability: Similarity only says how alike the two faces look; it does not say how likely they are the same person.

columns.similarity: Similarity (not the probability of being the same person)

step.first: Waiting for the first reviewer to compare and decide
step.second: Waiting for the second reviewer: must be a different person from the first reviewer

review.firstReviewer: First reviewer {{name}} decided it is the same person. As the second reviewer, compare the photos independently before confirming.

blocked.imageGone: The capture was deleted under the retention period, so it can no longer be reviewed.
blocked.cannotReview: You cannot submit a decision right now (no review permission for this store, or you are the first reviewer).

review.noReference: No reference photos are available (the entry may have been withdrawn or expired).
review.imageGone: The capture was deleted under the retention period, so this task can no longer be reviewed.

confirmMatch.title: Confirm "Same person"?
confirmMatch.content: You are deciding that the live capture and the reference photo show the same person (similarity {{percent}}%, not the probability of being the same person). The task only stands once the second reviewer confirms; the system never refuses service or notifies police automatically.

confirmNotMatch.title: Confirm "Not the same person"?
confirmNotMatch.content: If either reviewer says it is not the same person, the task is dismissed and ends.

review.submittedNotMatch: Recorded: not the same person, task dismissed

imageErrors.forbidden: You do not have permission to view this image
imageErrors.unauthorized: Your session has expired. Sign in again and retry
imageErrors.failed: Failed to load the image. Try again later
imageErrors.gone: The image has been cleaned up or does not exist

stats.intro: Review outcomes by entry and by similarity range: dismiss rate = dismissed / (dismissed + confirmed). A persistently high rate means many false positives; review whether the entry should stay on the list or raise the matching threshold. Counts only, no images or names.
stats.suggestBanner: {{count}} entry(ies) have a persistently high dismiss rate. Consider reviewing whether they should stay on the list.
stats.byScoreHint: Buckets of 5 points, for tuning the threshold: a high dismiss rate at low scores and a low one at high scores means the threshold is about right.
stats.suggestReview: Review whether this entry should stay on the list
